		then

		elif [[ "$arg" == "-g" || "$arg" == "-glm" ]]
		then
			use_glm=true 
		else

		fi
	done
	if $use_glm
	then
		claude-glm "${args[@]}"
	else
		command claude "${args[@]}"
	fi
